class.name: Box3DBallJoint
class.brief_description: A spherical joint: a point on one body is pinned to a point on the other, free to rotate.
class.description: A ball-and-socket. The bodies are pinned together at this node's origin and may rotate freely, unless the cone and twist limits narrow that down. Ragdoll shoulders and hips, chains, pendulums. The limits are measured about [b]this node's local Z axis[/b]: [member cone_angle] caps how far Z may tilt away from its rest direction, and the twist limits cap rotation about Z itself.

method.name: get_current_cone_angle
method.description: How far the joint axis is currently tilted from its rest direction, in radians. Compare with [member cone_angle], which is the limit rather than the reading.

method.name: get_current_twist_angle
method.description: The current twist about the joint axis, in radians.

method.name: get_motor_torque
method.description: Torque the motor applied on the last step, in newton-metres.

members.member: Half-angle of the allowed cone, in radians. 0 pins the axis, larger values open it up. Box3D accepts 0 to 90 degrees only: this is a half-angle, so 90 is already a full hemisphere of swing, and a larger value trips an assert in a debug build of Box3D.
Restricts how far the joint axis may swing away from its rest direction.

Dry friction in the joint, in newton-metres: a torque that resists any rotation, so a ragdoll limb settles instead of swinging forever. 0 is frictionless. It is shorthand for a motor with a zero velocity target, so it is [b]only applied while [member motor_enabled] is off[/b]; an explicit motor wins. [b]This and the motor share one motor[/b], which is the whole of the interaction between the four: turning [member motor_enabled] on hands the motor to [member motor_velocity] and [member max_motor_torque], turning it off hands it back to this. Changing any of them applies live, without rebuilding the joint, so friction can be nudged on a loaded ragdoll without popping it. Setting this wakes the bodies it holds; [member motor_enabled] and [member max_motor_torque] do not. A body frozen by friction can therefore fall asleep and then ignore the hand-back to an explicit motor -- wake it yourself, or keep [member Box3DBody.can_sleep] off on anything driven this way.

Torque budget for the motor, in newton-metres. Box3D clamps the motor's impulse to this times the step, so at 0 the motor moves nothing; the scene dock warns when [member motor_enabled] is on and this is 0.
Drives the relative angular velocity toward [member motor_velocity] within [member max_motor_torque] -- how a ragdoll limb is animated rather than merely constrained.
Target relative angular velocity, in radians per second about each axis of the joint frame.
Damping ratio of the spring, non-dimensional. 1.0 is critical damping (no overshoot); below 1 the joint oscillates. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Adds a spring pulling the joint back toward its rest orientation.
Stiffness of the spring, in cycles per second. Higher is stiffer. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Orientation the spring drives toward, as frame B relative to frame A. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Restricts rotation about the joint axis to [member twist_lower] .. [member twist_upper].
Lowest allowed twist about the joint axis, in radians.
Highest allowed twist about the joint axis, in radians.
